data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC steadies after strong rally, ETH and XRP ease into consolidation | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Ripple (XRP) bulls take a breather mid-week after gains of 6%, 4%, and 13% so far this week. BTC consolidates at $86,300, ETH hovers around $2,751, and XRP is at $1.57.
